Also, there's the principle of purpose limitation (Article 5(1)(b)), so data shouldn't be used for purposes beyond what was originally intended. Then there's storage limitation (Article 5(1)(e)), meaning data shouldn't be kept longer than needed. Transparency is also important, which includes informing users about data collection and usage, and getting consent where necessary.
